## Reviewer's Guide Introduces Phase 3 strategy/dispatch-decoupling contracts and zero-allocation command factories inside V12_002, adding internal interfaces, hot-path value types, and market/limit order factories that build FleetDispatchSlot payloads and compute shadows without locks or heap allocations. #### Sequence diagram for zero-allocation MarketOrderCommandFactory.Create flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant StrategyV12_002 as "V12_002" participant MarketFactory as "MarketOrderCommandFactory" participant ShadowCalculator as "ComputeFleetDispatchShadow" participant Envelope as "DispatchOrderEnvelope" StrategyV12_002->>MarketFactory: Create(action, followerQty, entryPrice, stopPrice, dispatchTargetCount, reservedDelta, poolSlotIndex, signalTicks, shadowSalt) activate MarketFactory MarketFactory->>MarketFactory: Initialize FleetDispatchSlot slot MarketFactory->>MarketFactory: Set EntryPrice, StopPrice, SignalTicks, PoolSlotIndex MarketFactory->>MarketFactory: Set OrderCount, Quantity, TargetCount, Action, ReservedDelta MarketFactory->>ShadowCalculator: ComputeFleetDispatchShadow(ref slot, shadowSalt) activate ShadowCalculator ShadowCalculator-->>MarketFactory: shadow deactivate ShadowCalculator MarketFactory->>MarketFactory: slot.Shadow = shadow MarketFactory->>Envelope: Construct DispatchOrderEnvelope(slot, poolSlotIndex) MarketFactory-->>StrategyV12_002: DispatchOrderEnvelope deactivate MarketFactory ``` #### Class diagram for Phase 3 strategy interfaces and command factories ```mermaid classDiagram class V12_002 { } class IFleetAccountFilter { +bool ShouldSkip(Account account, AccountRankInfo rankInfo, HashSet activeAccountSnapshot) } class IFollowerPricingEngine { +void ComputeFollowerPrices(OrderAction action, double entryPrice, double stopPrice, double t1, double t2, double t3, double t4, double t5) } class IFollowerFSMBuilder { +FollowerBracketFSM BuildPendingSubmit(Account account, string fleetEntryName, int followerQty, Order entry, Order stop, string ocoId, StagedTargetBuffer stagedTargets) } class DispatchOrderEnvelope { +FleetDispatchSlot Slot +int PoolSlotIndex +DispatchOrderEnvelope(FleetDispatchSlot slot, int poolSlotIndex) } class StagedTargetBuffer { +int Count +StagedTarget T1 +StagedTarget T2 +StagedTarget T3 +StagedTarget T4 +StagedTarget T5 +void Add(StagedTarget target) +StagedTarget At(int index) } class MarketOrderCommandFactory { +DispatchOrderEnvelope Create(OrderAction action, int followerQty, double entryPrice, double stopPrice, int dispatchTargetCount, int reservedDelta, int poolSlotIndex, long signalTicks, ulong shadowSalt) } class LimitOrderCommandFactory { +DispatchOrderEnvelope Create(OrderAction action, int followerQty, double limitPrice, int reservedDelta, int poolSlotIndex, long signalTicks, ulong shadowSalt) } class FleetDispatchSlot { +double EntryPrice +double StopPrice +long SignalTicks +int PoolSlotIndex +int OrderCount +int Quantity +int TargetCount +int Action +int ReservedDelta +ulong Shadow } class StagedTarget { } class Account { } class AccountRankInfo { } class Order { } class FollowerBracketFSM { } V12_002 o-- IFleetAccountFilter V12_002 o-- IFollowerPricingEngine V12_002 o-- IFollowerFSMBuilder V12_002 o-- DispatchOrderEnvelope V12_002 o-- StagedTargetBuffer V12_002 o-- MarketOrderCommandFactory V12_002 o-- LimitOrderCommandFactory DispatchOrderEnvelope *-- FleetDispatchSlot StagedTargetBuffer *-- StagedTarget IFollowerFSMBuilder ..> StagedTargetBuffer MarketOrderCommandFactory ..> DispatchOrderEnvelope MarketOrderCommandFactory ..> FleetDispatchSlot LimitOrderCommandFactory ..> DispatchOrderEnvelope LimitOrderCommandFactory ..> FleetDispatchSlot ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add internal Phase 3 dispatch-decoupling interfaces for fleet account filtering, follower pricing, and FSM building. |
  • Define IFleetAccountFilter with a ShouldSkip predicate over Account, AccountRankInfo, and active account snapshot.
  • Define IFollowerPricingEngine that computes follower stop and up to five target prices via out parameters.
  • Define IFollowerFSMBuilder that constructs a FollowerBracketFSM for pending submit using staged target data and account/order context.
| `src/V12_002.SIMA.StrategyFactories.cs` | | Introduce hot-path value types to carry dispatch data and staged targets without allocations. |
  • Add readonly DispatchOrderEnvelope struct that bundles a FleetDispatchSlot and its pool index for dispatch.
  • Add StagedTargetBuffer struct with fixed T1ÔÇôT5 fields, Count tracking, and Add/At helpers to avoid collections in the hot path.
| `src/V12_002.SIMA.StrategyFactories.cs` | | Implement zero-allocation market and limit order command factories that build FleetDispatchSlot payloads and compute shadow values lock-free. |
  • Add MarketOrderCommandFactory readonly struct with Create method that initializes FleetDispatchSlot for a market entry, including quantities, prices, target counts, reserved delta, and shadow computation.
  • Add LimitOrderCommandFactory readonly struct with Create method that initializes FleetDispatchSlot for a single-leg limit order and computes shadow.
  • Ensure both factories return DispatchOrderEnvelope and rely on struct usage and in/ref parameters for performance, with no lock statements introduced.
| `src/V12_002.SIMA.StrategyFactories.cs` | ---
